title: RecentRepositoryList
description: Repositories the user has opened before, most recently used first. Returned by repository.listRecent.

entries.description: Remembered repositories, ordered by last use, most recent first.

recentRepository.title: RecentRepository
recentRepository.description: One remembered repository. The entry survives the directory being deleted or moved, so the interface can offer to forget it rather than failing when the user clicks.

path.description: Absolute path to the worktree root, as it was when the repository was last opened.

name.description: Display name recorded when the repository was last opened.

lastOpenedUtc.description: UTC instant at which the repository was last opened.

available.description: False when the path no longer exists or is no longer a git working tree. The entry is still listed, marked, and can be forgotten.
